---
title: Fish Broth Soup
id: MAR-0086
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 400 g ramati tomato
- 200 g spaghettini
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste scant 1 l fish fumet
- 2 cloves garlic
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Blanch the tomatoes in lightly salted water for about 30 seconds.
2. Drain them, peel them, remove the seeds and chop the remaining pulp.
3. Crush the garlic and peel it; let it wilt in a saucepan with the oil for 3 minutes, then remove it.
4. Add the tomato, salt, pepper, stir and after 3 minutes add the fish fumet and let cook for 20 minutes.
5. Break the spaghettini, pour them into the boiling fumet and when cooked, serve the soup in deep bowls.
